**Practice Sentences (7 sentences with natural flow):**

Diego stepped off the plane and looked around the busy airport.
[PAUSE 5s]

He held $20 in his pocket and could not speak English, and he felt scared and alone.
[PAUSE 5s]

Diego worked twelve hours every day, and he saved every dollar he earned, and he lived on only $3 a day.
[PAUSE 5s]

Every Sunday, Diego and Elena pooled their money together, and they went to an all-you-can-eat restaurant as their weekly treat.
[PAUSE 5s]

After five years of hard work, Diego owned three restaurants, and he became a millionaire, and he felt successful and proud.
[PAUSE 5s]

But one day, everything changed in an instant, and Diego received a phone call late at night.
[PAUSE 5s]

The fire destroyed everything he had built, and Diego lost his restaurants and all his money, and he felt helpless and lost.
[PAUSE 5s]
